data.title: 史黛菈 · 露天温泉的绯红水汽
data.description: 深山温泉旅馆的私人露天浴池，周围枫叶如火。史黛菈浸泡在腾起白茫茫水汽的温泉水中，湿透的深红秀发贴在光洁玉背与丰满胸口前。水波泛着微光，热气将她雪白的肌肤蒸得如晚霞般绯红娇艳。她单手掬起一捧温水，转头看向岸边，眼神中透着皇女特有的骄傲与极尽深情。
data.location: secluded private outdoor hot spring bath surrounded by rocks
data.action: soaking in steaming outdoor hot spring, wet crimson hair clinging to bare shoulders, maple leaves floating, water droplets on flushed skin, proud yet blushing gaze at viewer
data.lighting: dappled sunlight through red autumn leaves hitting steamy water surface
data.mood: vibrant passionate beauty, secluded autumn warmth
data.promptProse: Soaking in a steamy outdoor hot spring surrounded by scarlet maple leaves, Stella looks back with damp crimson hair. Water ripples around her bare shoulders as her skin glows warmly in the autumn light.
data.animaCaption: Stella resting in an outdoor hot spring under falling maple leaves, her flushed skin glowing in steam.
